page.overview:
Who is Bryan D. Furen?

Bryan D. Furen was a Starfleet officer in the 24th century.

In 2364, as a captain, he was the commander of the . Early that year, he received an order about the Kandari sector com mode from Admiral Kurt Nelson of Starfleet Tactical Command. (, okudagram)
